_meta.source: Enoserv RTS FasData7 (snapshot 2026-04-15) — harvested manufacturer relay test-acceptance tolerances
_meta.description: Per-element relay accuracy bands keyed by (manufacturer, normalized relay_type). pickup_pct/time_pct = percent acceptance window as [low, high] deviation; pickup_abs/time_abs = absolute floor [low, high] (A for pickup, s for timing). Values are manufacturer-published accuracy specifications extracted from the operator's licensed Enoserv install; Enoserv test scripts/library are NOT included.
_meta.tier: PRIMARY (above Relays.Note seed and the NETA generic floor)
